_comment: Bounded source manifest for the ASHWOOD workspace workstream projection publisher (agent-os issue #54). This is projection CONFIG, not an execution database: it lists which canonical AgentOS source objects to project and the stable human-facing descriptors for each. Volatile execution state (title, canonical_url, status) is derived live from the source object at publish time, never copied here. Do not record task progress, assignments, or review lifecycle in this file.

sources.next_gate: Independent reviewer re-runs the live enforcement suite against the disposable lab and records a VERIFIED or BLOCKED verdict on github_lab_merge. Remaining real proof, not stale issue text.
First reviewed outreach batch to TK, then discovery/pilot progression.
